name: isBackupImmutable
definition: Backup data is held under an immutability control (for example object lock with a default retention) that stops it being altered or deleted before its retention ends.
population: the backup storage targets the integration lists, with their immutability or object-lock settings
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A target listing in which at least one target shows immutability on together with an enforced retention mode and period.
citations: Backblaze B2 native API reference, b2_list_buckets: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-list-buckets

changeLog.change: Registered with the Backblaze B2 transforms. Other backup integrations already emit this key; their meaning is not yet validated against this entry.

notes: Backblaze B2: fileLockConfiguration with isFileLockEnabled and a defaultRetention mode and period. Object Lock without a default retention does not count.
